message.Title: Generally Available: Voice Live integration with Microsoft Foundry Agent Service

Body.Content:
Microsoft Foundry Agent Service is now generally available for Voice Live integration, allowing developers to connect real-time speech-to-text and text-to-speech to a Foundry Agent without writing their own audio pipeline. Existing agent capabilities — including tool calling, knowledge, memory, guardrails, and enterprise integrations — continue to work seamlessly and are now enhanced with low-latency speech interactions. The agent provides a real-time streaming voice channel with interrupt handling, turn-taking, barge-in support, connection management, natural voices, and avatars for production phone and web experiences. For customers building customer service agents, learning companions, and in-car assistants, this provides a single supported path from Foundry agent logic to live audio input and output, instead of requiring them to stitch together Speech, the agent runtime, and WebRTC on their own.  

Learn more.
